name: diagnose_error_from_stacktrace
responsibility: Diagnose root cause and recommend fix from error stacktraces
trigger_description: Explain an error, debug a crash, or interpret a stacktrace when error context and code snippets are provided.

parts.content: Read the stacktrace carefully to identify: (1) the exact line and operation that failed, (2) the exception/error type, (3) the immediate cause (null/nil dereference, index out of range, missing resource, etc.). Trace backward through the call stack to understand how execution reached the failure point.

Analyze the provided context to determine the root cause: look for unvalidated inputs, missing initialization, unchecked error returns, race conditions, or environmental assumptions. Distinguish between the symptom (the crash location) and the root cause (where the invalid state originated).

Propose a specific fix that addresses the root cause: add validation/guards at the point where bad data enters, initialize required fields before use, check error returns before proceeding, or add defensive nil/bounds checks. Explain why the fix prevents recurrence.

Structure the response: (1) one-sentence summary of what failed, (2) root cause explanation referencing specific code locations, (3) recommended fix with code-level specificity (which file, function, what to add/change), (4) optional preventive measures if the pattern suggests systemic issues.
